title: fix(driver-sql, driver-turso): SQLite $contains / $notContains / $icontains / $endsWith read the whole stored value, not only up to its first U+0000
body:
Part of #20024

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

This takes item 1 of #20024, the stored value's cut. Item 2 (`$like` / `$ilike`) stays open on #20024 for a decision; see "Item 2" below.

On the SQLite faces, `$contains`, `$notContains`, `$icontains` and `$endsWith` compiled to `GLOB` for a comparand without U+0000. SQLite's `glob()` reads the stored value as a C string, only up to its first U+0000. So `$contains: 'b'` missed a value stored as `'a'` + U+0000 + `'b'`, `$endsWith: 'a'` returned it, and `$icontains: 'B'` missed `'A'` + U+0000 + `'B'`. Nothing raised. #19999 (PR #20019, `9d81af714f`) had already moved a comparand that HOLDS U+0000 onto length-aware constructs; this sends every `contains` / `ends` comparand there, which is option A of contract review 5821310673 (reconfirmed in 5822054158).

| shape | SQLite predicate, every comparand |
|---|---|
| `contains` (`$contains`, `$notContains`, `$icontains`) | `instr(col, ?) > 0` |
| `ends` (`$endsWith`), non-empty comparand | `coalesce(substr(CAST(col AS BLOB), -length(CAST(? AS BLOB))), CAST(col AS BLOB)) = CAST(? AS BLOB)` |
| `ends`, empty comparand | `instr(col, ?) > 0` |
| `starts` (`$startsWith`), comparand without U+0000 | `col GLOB ?`, unchanged byte for byte |
| `starts`, comparand holding U+0000 | `instr(col, ?) = 1`, unchanged from #19999 |

- **The empty `$endsWith` comparand** needed its own route. In the suffix construct `-length('')` is `-0`, which `substr` reads as "from the start", so the construct would answer false for `'abc'`. Measured on all three engines: the suffix construct with `''` answers 0 on `'abc'`, while `instr('abc', '')` and `instr('', '')` are both 1 and `instr(NULL, '')` is NULL, which is what `GLOB '*'` answered. An empty string is a suffix of every value, so it takes `instr()`.
- **`$startsWith` keeps `GLOB`.** A prefix free of U+0000 lies wholly before the value's first U+0000, or it is not a prefix at all, so the value's cut cannot change that answer (0 of 14 `$startsWith` probe cases differed at base, including values that start with U+0000). It is also the one text construct an index serves; see H3.
- The fold is still `lower()` on both sides, ASCII-only. The negation is still `NOT (...)` inside the unchanged NULL-safe `$notContains` wrapper. Nothing is escaped, because `instr()` and the BLOB suffix have no pattern language, so `*`, `?` and `[` are bound as written.
- Two emitters change: `textMatchPredicate` / `sqliteLengthAwareTextMatch` in `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`, and `RemoteTransport.pushLike` in `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/remote-transport.ts`. `SqliteWasmDriver` and `TursoDriver`'s local mode inherit the first. No refusal door, no `packages/spec` file and no shared conformance table is touched.

## Measured at base `9d81af714` (hypotheses H1, H2, H5)

A 292-case probe drove the public `find` of six faces over 17 stored values (U+0000 at start, middle and end, alone and doubled, multi-byte UTF-8 around it, GLOB and LIKE metacharacters behind it, `''` and NULL), on dists built at base:

- `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3 (SQLite 3.53.4);
- `SqliteWasmDriver` on sql.js (3.49.1);
- `TursoDriver` local;
- `TursoDriver` remote over a real `@libsql/client` `:memory:` engine (SQLite 3.45.1);
- `InMemoryDriver`, and `@objectstack/formula` `matchesFilterCondition` as the oracle.

The cases were 5 text operators times 19 comparands (14 without U+0000, 5 with), each bare and under `$not`; 36 `$like` and 9 `$ilike` patterns, each bare and under `$not`; and 12 `$not` / `$or` / `$and` compositions.

| cases (per SQLite face) | differ from `formula` at base | at head |
|---|---|---|
| text operators, comparand without U+0000, bare | 38 of 70 | 0 of 70 |
| the same under `$not` | 38 of 70 | 0 of 70 |
| text operators, comparand holding U+0000, bare and under `$not` | 0 of 50 | 0 of 50 |
| compositions | 10 of 12 | 3 of 12, each with a `$like` leg |
| `$like` / `$ilike`, bare and under `$not` | 62 of 90 | 62 of 90 (item 2, unchanged) |

- **H1 holds.** Per operator at base, bare: `$contains` 8 of 14, `$notContains` 8 of 14, `$icontains` 9 of 14, `$endsWith` 13 of 14. The four SQLite faces gave byte-identical answer lists on all 292 cases, at base and at head.
- **H2 holds.** `$startsWith` with a comparand without U+0000: 0 of 14 differ, bare and under `$not`, at base and at head.
- **H5 holds.** `$icontains: 'É'` returns `'CAFÉ'` + U+0000 and `$icontains: 'é'` does not; the fold stays `lower()` on both sides.
- `InMemoryDriver` equals `formula` on 292 of 292 at base and at head (the control). No face raised on any case, at base or at head.

The constructs themselves were measured with SQL literals, no bind, over 16 comparands without U+0000 (including `*?[y`, `%`, `_`, U+0001 and multi-byte ones), 23 stored values and both folds: `instr() > 0`, the BLOB suffix, and `NOT` over each, three-valued against JavaScript `includes` / `endsWith` (NULL expected on NULL). That is 2944 cells per engine and 0 disagreements on each of better-sqlite3 3.53.4, sql.js 3.49.1 and libSQL 3.45.1.

## H3: the plans

`EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` of the SQL `SqlDriver` compiles, run over `create table plan_probe (id integer primary key, v text)` with an index on `v`, on each engine:

| filter | base (`GLOB`) | head |
|---|---|---|
| `$contains: 'ab'` | `SCAN plan_probe` | `SCAN plan_probe` (`instr`) |
| `$notContains: 'ab'` | `SCAN` | `SCAN` |
| `$icontains: 'Ab'` | `SCAN` | `SCAN` |
| `$endsWith: 'ab'` | `SCAN` | `SCAN` (BLOB suffix) |
| `$startsWith: 'ab'` | `SEARCH plan_probe USING COVERING INDEX plan_probe_v (v>? AND v<?)` | the same |
| `$like: 'ab%'` | `SEARCH … USING COVERING INDEX plan_probe_v (v>? AND v<?)` | the same |
| `$eq: 'ab'` (control) | `SEARCH … (v=?)` | the same |

Identical on better-sqlite3, sql.js and libSQL. H3 holds: the four moved shapes scanned under `GLOB` already, so no index plan is lost. The remote transport's statements were not put through `EXPLAIN`; they are the same constructs, pinned by text in `turso-20024-glob-stored-nul.test.ts`.

## Item 2 (`$like` / `$ilike`) is not in this PR

Measured, and left for a decision on #20024:

- **There is no NUL-safe pattern primitive to compile to.** `GLOB` and `LIKE` both stop at U+0000. The way around it I tried first, substituting a sentinel for U+0000 in the value and the pattern, is dead: SQLite's `replace()` treats a search string whose first byte is 0 as empty and returns its input unchanged. `hex(replace('a' || char(0) || 'b', char(0), char(1)))` is `610062` on all three engines. Over a grid of 52 patterns, 23 values and both folds (2392 cells per engine), `GLOB` disagrees with `@objectstack/spec` `matchesLikePattern` on 294 cells and the sentinel construct still on 223. `instr()` does not apply, because the pattern has wildcards, and `_` is one character, so a byte-level BLOB program would have to decode UTF-8 lengths.
- **The stored-value cut also hits a pattern without U+0000**, which the card's item 2 does not name: at base and at head, 15 of the probe's 23 such `$like` patterns differ from `formula` on every SQLite face. For example, `$like: 'a'` returns `'a'` + U+0000 + `'b'`, and `$like: ''` returns U+0000 + `'z'`. No refusal can reach this half, because it depends on stored data.
- **A refusal is a cross-face contract question.** The dangling-escape refusal of a `$like` pattern is one spec predicate (`hasDanglingLikeEscape`) applied at every face's refusal door. The same shape for U+0000 needs `packages/spec` and the refusal doors that #20020 is working in, and what Postgres and MySQL do with such a pattern is not measured here (no live server). A SQLite-only refusal would make SQLite the one face that refuses what `driver-memory` answers.

The options, with the measured costs, are in the `os-dev-report` on #20024.

| half | objectql `applyHaving` | **measured unaffected** | Over 9 stored values, 6 of them holding U+0000, 30 cases (5 operators times 6 comparands without U+0000): 29 equal `formula`; `$icontains: ''` is refused, the pre-existing refusal driver-sql shares. |
| thawed | `driver-memory` `checkCondition` | **measured unaffected** | 292 of 292 probe cases equal `formula`, at base and at head. |
| thawed | `driver-mongodb` `translateFieldOperators` | not touched, **NOT MEASURED** | No mongod in this container. |

## Tests

- New suites, each case pinned literally: `sql-driver-20024-glob-stored-nul.test.ts` (74 tests), `sqlite-wasm-20024-glob-stored-nul.test.ts` (24), `turso-20024-glob-stored-nul.test.ts` (26, three transports per case). The driver-sql and sqlite-wasm suites also check every case against `formula`; the turso cases are a subset of the driver-sql rows. They cover the four moved operators, `$startsWith` (H2), the empty comparand, and `$not` / `$or` / `$and` over each moved shape with the `''` and NULL rows in every answer set. The compile block pins the new SQL and raw bindings, the empty-`$endsWith` route, and `$startsWith`'s `GLOB` plus its escaped pattern byte for byte.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `667eddc47`: 183 files passed, 11 skipped (live-dialect cells); 2811 tests passed, 170 skipped.
- `driver-turso` 65 of 65 files, 1471 of 1471 tests, and `driver-sqlite-wasm` 32 of 32 files, 606 of 606 tests, at `cf0590562`, whose code is byte-identical to `667eddc47` (the one later commit adds only the changeset).
- `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) exits 0 in all three packages, and `tsc --listFiles` shows each program includes its new suite.
- ESLint, narrowed: `--no-inline-config --format json` over the 15 changed TS files reports 15 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored (every file resolves a config through `--print-config`). `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, as its own comment says), so this diff cannot move the verdict of a file it does not touch. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Before-red and ablations (one-off; no test left behind)

Both ran from committed state through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor counts and blob hashes checked on disk, restore proven as blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty), with `driver-sql` rebuilt and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirming the mutation in `dist/` before the suites ran, because `driver-sqlite-wasm` and turso's local mode read that dist.

- **Ablation 1, the dispatch reverted in both emitters** (`if (shape !== 'starts' || text.includes(NUL_CHARACTER))` back to base's `if (text.includes(NUL_CHARACTER))`), which is base behaviour. Predicted by simulating `GLOB`'s cut over each suite's cases, then observed exactly: driver-sql 24 failed and 50 passed of 74 (22 row cases plus the moved-shapes and empty-`$endsWith` compile pins; the `$startsWith` pin stayed green); sqlite-wasm 16 failed and 8 passed of 24; turso 18 failed and 8 passed of 26. In the 12 turso row diffs whose three columns printed in full, `local`, `remote` and `remoteLibsql` were all wrong the same way; the base probe had already found local mode and remote-over-libSQL byte-identical to the other SQLite faces on all 292 cases.
- **Ablation 2, the empty-comparand route removed** (`shape === 'ends' && text !== ''` to `shape === 'ends'`, both emitters). Predicted and observed: driver-sql 3 failed of 74 (`$endsWith ''`, `$not $endsWith ''`, the empty-`$endsWith` compile pin), sqlite-wasm 2 of 24, turso 3 of 26.
- After each: `git status --porcelain` empty, `driver-sql` rebuilt, and preflight reads the guard back in `dist/` with the tree clean.

## Gates (at `667eddc47`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 commands from the real diff, the same 62 the PM list named. All 62 were run.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:type-check-debt` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3). They answered 0 after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*'` (72 tasks). `check:dts-closure`, `check:published-files` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` were re-run over that build and answered 0.
  - `--ran`: "62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- `check-changeset-no-major`: "This diff introduces no `major` bump." `check-adr-0087-registration`: "this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (1 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)."
- `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --base 9d81af714`: 12 citations across 2 files, all resolve.
- `pnpm check:driver-conformance` reads the same before (on a `git archive` of `9d81af714`) and after: `50 covered cell(s), 0 in the DEBT ledger, 0 exempt`.
- The roster gates whose roster sits beside these paths also exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`.
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` passes, and a control-byte scan of the changed files finds none. U+0000 is spelled `String.fromCharCode(0x00)` throughout.

1. **Item 2 of #20024 is open and needs a decision** (above; options in the `os-dev-report`).
